items.q: Which one is not an out-of-home format?
items.why: Pre-roll plays before online video. The others are seen outside the home.

items.q: Which one is not a core web performance metric?
items.why: CPM is a price. LCP, CLS and INP describe how a page loads and responds.

items.q: Which one is not a CTV device or platform?
items.why: A newspaper is print. The others can stream video to a TV screen.

items.q: Which one is not a way to sell app inventory?
items.why: Robots.txt tells search crawlers what to read. The others are ways to sell ad space.

items.q: Which one is not a CTV measurement idea?
items.why: Scroll depth is a web page measure. CTV is judged by completion, reach and frequency.

items.q: Which one is not something digital out-of-home screens can do?
options: Show different ads by time of day
Reprint a paper poster for each change
items.why: Reprinting is what static posters need. Digital screens can change content instantly.

items.q: Which one is not usually controlled by a web publisher?
items.why: Advertisers set their own budgets. Publishers control layout, placements and floors.
